$comment: Every icon the app draws, keyed to the node in `docs/KHAZAYIN.fig` it is
drawn from. `node` is a Figma guid — a SYMBOL master where the design uses
a shared component (so the geometry comes from one place rather than from
whichever instance happened to be picked), and the glyph's own container
where it is drawn in place.
`__tests__/figmaIcons.test.ts` fails if the generated file drifts from it.

notDrawn.name: SectionExclusiveSeal
notDrawn.why: The word خزائن الرحمن on the حصريات card is a raster IMAGE paint, not vector, so the geometry walk cannot reach it — `SectionExclusive` carries the gold disc and the vector letterforms around it. The word itself comes out of the archive at its source 139x164 with alpha intact as assets/figma/seal-khazain.png; see scripts/figma/extract-images.js.
